scoredJobs.title: Recruitment Partner (Inclusive Employment Australia)
mandatoryRequirements: Relevant qualifications in areas such as Employment Services, Community Services or other relevant areas
Previous experience in employment services including advanced barrier management, reverse marketing, placement of candidates into employment and provision of post-placement support
Must hold a Driver's license as travel throughout the region will be required
preferredRequirements: Demonstrated experience in business development, account management or sales
Strong networking and relationship building skills
Working knowledge of local employers and their recruitment demands
Demonstrated ability to communicate through various methods with a wide variety of stakeholders
Performance focused mindset and proven experience achieving business targets and KPI's
responsibilities: Support employers in the Maroondah, Bayside and Monash regions in collaboration with local teams
Maintain an in-depth knowledge of the local labour market and emerging industries, with the goal of achieving ongoing employment opportunities
Proactively identify and develop new employer relationships, taking time to understand our employers' staffing needs and providing tailored recruitment solutions
Help employers adapt their process or roles to accommodate candidates with specific needs and maximising productivity and other benefits towards achieving their organisational goals
Engage job ready candidates and match with employers through referrals, job carving and reverse marketing to achieve sustainable outcomes

Work closely with the Employment Consultants and Ongoing Support Consultants to build opportunities in industries relevant to the caseloads needs and provide post placement support to participants and their employers
Achieve or exceed all KPIs and apply an outcome focused, high performance approach to the role
Work closely alongside people with a disability to help them build their future career
